No, that is incorrect. 9.9 is actually greater than 9.11.

To compare decimal numbers, you look at each digit from left to right. In this case:
- 9.9 = 9.90
- 9.11 = 9.11

The whole number part (9) is the same, so you compare the decimal parts. 0.90 is greater than 0.11.

Therefore, 9.9 > 9.11.
